title: Coding sessions are longer and use more context. Claude Opus 5.5 is built for that.
summary: Opus 5.5 is a new model designed for longer, context-heavy coding sessions, running ~40% cheaper than Opus 5 with 60% cheaper cache reads and 30% faster output generation. Built on usage data showing developers now run significantly longer sessions, it maintains superior performance while improving cost efficiency.

title: Claude Tag now supports personal connectors in channels
summary: Claude Tag in Slack channels now supports personal connectors (Google Drive, calendar, CRM) alongside shared connectors, enabling Claude to synthesize public channel data with private user data while maintaining role-based access controls. Users can choose between review and auto modes for responses.

title: Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude
summary: Claude Cowork and chat are now unified into a single interface with new Claude Docs, Slides (beta), and integrated Design capabilities. All features, connectors, and skills are now accessible from any conversation, eliminating the need to choose between separate tools.

title: Salesforce in Claude
summary: A new beta Salesforce plugin integrates CRM data directly into Claude with 37 sales-focused skills and connectors respecting existing permissions. Early customers report generating meeting briefs in seconds instead of hours, with capabilities spanning account research, deal scoring, and pipeline reviews.

title: Claude Marketplace: one place to discover plugins, agents, and services from our partners
summary: Launch of Claude Marketplace, a unified hub consolidating 2,000+ plugins, Claude-powered agents and products, and consulting services. Customers can apply existing Anthropic commitments to marketplace offerings, streamlining procurement and giving partners direct access to Claude's customer base.

title: How CodeRabbit, Power Digital, and ThoughtSpot scale with Snowflake and Vercel on Claude Marketplace
summary: Case study showing how CodeRabbit, Power Digital, and ThoughtSpot use Claude Marketplace to integrate Snowflake and Vercel services. Customers redirect existing Anthropic commitments to partner services, streamlining procurement and consolidating vendor approvals into a single process.
